## Version 2026.10

This release improves AI chat. Chats now keep their full tool-call history between turns and are attributed to a team,
and the admin has a readable view of each conversation. It also upgrades Python dependencies (including Wagtail 8)
and finishes cleaning up hardcoded CSS classes.

### AI Chat Improvements

- **Chats now save the full pydantic-ai message history, including tool calls.**
  A new `Chat.message_history` field stores the structured history after each agent run, so later turns
  keep the context of earlier tool calls. Previously the history was rebuilt from the plain-text `ChatMessage` rows,
  which lost that context. Older chats, or chats with unreadable history, still fall back to the old behavior.
- **New chats are attributed to the user's current team** (on builds with teams enabled).
  `Chat` has a new optional `team` field, which is set when a chat is created from the API or the websocket consumer.
  This is for attribution, like usage reporting. It doesn't control access, and chats stay private to their user.
- **Improved the chat admin.** The `Chat` admin now has a formatted, color-coded view of the full message history
  (user messages, assistant replies, tool calls and results, thinking, retries, and so on), plus a team column and filter.
- Refactored agent streaming. Stream events are now mapped to UI events by a single `map_stream_event()` function
  in a new `apps/ai/events.py` module, and the streaming loop moved into `ChatSession`.
  `run_agent` and `run_agent_streaming` were removed from `apps/ai/agents.py`.
- Moved the logic for naming a chat from its first message into a single `name_chat_from_message()` helper,
  used by both the API views and `ChatSession`. Messages shorter than 40 characters (previously 30) are used
  as the chat name as-is, and longer ones are summarized by the LLM in a background task.
- Added a request-free `get_default_team(user, session)` helper in `apps/teams/helpers.py`, so the current team
  can be looked up where there is no request, like in a websocket consumer.
  `get_default_team_from_request` now calls it.
- Raised the admin database MCP server's startup timeout to 30 seconds.
- Fixed a bug where the chat response task failed on Django Ninja builds because it serialized the message the DRF way.
- Chat tests other than the API tests are now kept on HTMX-only and Django Ninja builds. Before, the whole chat test
  directory was removed on those builds.
- Rewrote the `ChatSession` history tests to use pydantic-ai's `TestModel`.

### Other Changes

- **Upgraded Python dependencies.** Notable upgrades include Wagtail 8.0, OpenAI 3, Anthropic 1.2, pydantic-ai 2.36,
  Django REST Framework 3.18, and the Pegasus CLI 0.16.
  Django stays on 6.0.x, because `django-celery-beat` doesn't support Django 6.1 yet.
- Added a few Wagtail 8 dependencies that have no type stubs to the mypy ignore list.
- Fixed the last hardcoded `pg-` CSS classes in the Tailwind templates (login, signup, pricing page, and plan selector),
  some Python form code, and the standalone React frontend. These now respect the "use Pegasus CSS classes" setting.
  Also removed a leftover Bulma `is-size-6` class from the plan selector.

### Upgrading

This release adds new migrations for the `Chat` model (`message_history`, and `team` on team-enabled builds).
Run `./manage.py migrate` after upgrading.
